lines: Aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hone tak
couplets.en: A sigh takes a lifetime to have its effect.

lines: Aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hone tak
Kaun jeeta hai teri zulf ke sar hone tak
couplets.en: A sigh takes a lifetime to have its effect, and who lives to see your tresses mastered?

lines: Kaun jeeta hai teri zulf ke sar hone tak
couplets.en: Who lives to see your tresses mastered?
Love asks for patience, and longing cannot wait.

lines: Dil ka kya rang karun khoon-e-jigar hone tak
couplets.en: What color shall I give my heart until the blood of my liver is ready?

lines: Ham ne maana ke taghaful na karoge lekin
couplets.en: I grant you will not look away, and yet.

lines: Khaak ho jaenge ham tum ko khabar hone tak
Aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hone tak
couplets.en: I will be dust by the time you hear, for a sigh takes a lifetime to have its effect.

lines: Gham-e-hasti ka Asad kis se ho juz marg ilaaj
couplets.en: Asad, what but death can cure the sorrow of being?

lines: Gham-e-hasti ka Asad kis se ho juz marg ilaaj
Sham'a har rang mein jalti hai sahar hone tak
couplets.en: Asad, what but death can cure the sorrow of being, when the candle burns through every hue until dawn?
